Title: Public preview: Metrics and alerts support in Azure Container Apps

Body.Content:
Azure Container Apps, a service for building and deploying modern applications and microservices using serverless containers, now supports metrics and alerts which provide visibility into the activity of running container apps.

Use the Metrics Explorer to see the CPU, memory, network activity, and requests your container apps are using. Setup alerts on metric thresholds or Log Analytics queries.

Learn more.
